about_the_game:
Fantasy medieval Rus’, XIII-th century. Ivan the Bard dreams of becoming rich and famous and marrying the prince's daughter, but he has no luck: Ivan is not invited to play at feasts, and even simple girls do not want to date him.

One day fate gives the young man a chance. Ivan meets a magical assistant who promises to fulfil his daring dream. However, the way to the heart of the princess is not simple, and it's not just a matter of social limits.

Now Ivan will have to get acquainted with three different girls and experience a unique story with each in order to uncover the secrets of female nature, to gain courage, resourcefulness and self-confidence. Will it help him to win the princess’s heart or will a series of choices lead Ivan to a completely different fate?

"The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard" is a non-linear visual novel in the genre of historical fantasy. The plot is inspired by Russian medieval history and the epic songs of the Nordic tradition.

  • Travel through the fairy-tale medieval Novgorod, communicate with locals, experience adventures with each of the three girls - romantic, dangerous and funny.

  • Participate in side stories, learn more about the history and culture of the great Russian medieval city.

  • Complete musical mini-games: learn new epics and gusli tunes. This will help in completing the plot!

  • The visual style of the game is inspired by the traditions of Russian book illustration, in particular, the works of Ivan Bilibin

  • The soundtrack combines folk and modern motifs

  • Many in-game choices, more than six endings

In this novel you are not playing as a knight, a hero or a mercenary. Your character is a simple guy with a gusli, which means his only weapons are eloquence and music. One careless word can make your interlocutor hostile. One well-chosen remark can set a girl in a romantic mood. Choose wisely.
